newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kemira says three injured in Dutch blast.
newsitem.headline: Kemira says three injured in Dutch blast.

text.p: Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy said on Tuesday three people had been injured in an explosion at its pigments division's plant in Rotterdam, which was not in production at the time.
"Today around 1045 GMT there was a strong explosion at Kemira Pigments Rotterdam plant which injured three people," Kemira said in a statement.
The explosion did not cause any fire and its cause was unknown, it said, adding that it suspects the accident was connected with maintenance operations underway at the time.
The annual production capacity of the Rotterdam plant is 56,000 tonnes, around 20 percent of Kemira Pigments total capacity, a Kemira spokesman said.
Damages run to millions of markka and re-starting production will take several weeks, Kemira said.
The spokesman said Kemira had not yet decided whether to increase production at other plants to make up for the downtime.
